details: Definition. Strict on the three-code class: $\mathrm{pUSC}=2$ while $\mathrm{USC}=1$.
proof: Proper unlabeled compression requires the reconstruction to belong to $\mathcal H$, an additional restriction beyond ordinary unlabeled compression. Restricting the allowed schemes cannot decrease the minimum size.
name: Proper Unlabeled Sample Compression / Unlabeled sample compression
